subject: config: Change tidb_opt_projection_push_down default value to true (#53831)
summary: This commit only flips `pkg/config/config.go` default `Performance.ProjectionPushDown` from `false` to `true`, changing the default session sysvar `tidb_opt_projection_push_down` (via `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go` and startup `cmd/tidb-server/main.go:setGlobalVars()`). Planner behavior itself is unchanged; it already gates projection-to-cop pushdown on `AllowProjectionPushDown` plus `expression.CanExprsPushDown`, virtual-column exclusion, and `ProjectionBenefitsFromPushedDown` in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go`. The rest of the diff is expected plan/result updates plus a few tests explicitly setting the sysvar to `0` to stabilize test assumptions. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, concurrency, or session behavior. Later upstream history adds upgrade-compat handling to keep the variable `false` when upgrading from versions older than 8.3.0 (`6854e60698`, PR #54861), leaving no remaining Blocker/High concerns.
